## Scope

### Goal

Produce stable \*human-readable\* Markdown.

### Deliverables

- Golden projection
- Drift detector

### In Scope

- LF normalization
- Table escaping

### Out of Scope

- Arbitrary Markdown editing

## Decisions, Assumptions, and Questions

| Item | Type | Decision | Reason | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Projection ownership | Decision | Mino owns generated bytes | The JSON aggregate remains authoritative | Accepted |

## Interfaces and Data Flow

Plan \+ state hash -\> UTF-8 Markdown<br>Existing bytes \+ prior rendering -\> guarded write

## Edge Cases

| Case | Expected Behavior | Covered By |
